curves.line: I know there's a reason we use such curves
stanza: I know there's a reason we use such curves
Riddles in smiles rather than small talk
I know we both want things to be done
In a truthful manner
There lies our rest, my dear friend

nerves.line: And the time that he served had shattered all his nerves
stanza: Sam Stone came home to his wife and family
After serving in the conflict overseas
And the time that he served had shattered all his nerves
And left a little shrapnel in his knee
But the morphine eased the pain and the grass grew 'round his brain
And gave him all the confidence he lacked
With a Purple Heart and a monkey on his back

nerves.line: Ah, you short-circuit all my nerves
stanza: Ah, you short-circuit all my nerves
Promising electric things
You touch me and
Suddenly there's rainbow rings
But I spotted a damsel
If memory serves
I spotted a damsel
If memory serves
